verdict.rationale: The evidence shows official client-side integrations: a Segment-compatible JavaScript library, a React integration, and an HTML snippet. There is also a Functions SDK/CLI for building TypeScript functions. Backend and management access is documented only as a raw HTTP API with an OpenAPI reference, and the probe found no openapi.json at the usual paths. Missing for 10: official server-side language SDKs (e.g., Node/Python/Go), typed client SDKs for the Management API, a fetchable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
